presentation_title: Effective Prompting: Your Key AI Skill
module: Welcome! If you're not a coder, this is your single most important skill for using AI.
episode: 2: Effective Prompting: Your AI Communication Skill
learning_objectives: Identify the three essential components for clear AI prompts.
Apply techniques like persona and structured output for precise AI responses.
Formulate effective prompts for various AI tasks.
outline: AI as a Smart Intern Analogy
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with using a large language model (LLM) such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, or Claude.

slides.title: Welcome: Effective Prompting
narration: Namaste! Welcome to this tutorial on effective AI prompting.
In today's world, communicating with AI is vital.
Even without coding, this skill helps you use AI well.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot hand holding a pen, writing on a notepad. Futuristic and clean design.

slides.title: What You Will Learn
content: Identify the three essential parts of a good AI prompt.
Apply techniques like persona and structured output for precise AI responses.

narration: In this session, you will learn to identify three important parts of a good AI prompt.
You will learn to use techniques to get accurate AI answers.
Finally, you will learn to make good prompts for different AI tasks.

slides.title: Talk to AI, Get Results
narration: An AI model is like a super-smart, fast assistant, ready for any task!
But like any assistant, it needs clear instructions.
Your communication with AI directly impacts its output.
This is where the skill of prompting becomes essential.
slides.image_prompt: A person interacting with a glowing, abstract AI interface, looking productive and satisfied. Soft, friendly digital light.

slides.title: What is Prompting?
narration: Prompting is simply telling AI what to do.
It's like talking, but you need to be very specific.
A good prompt helps you get the right results from AI tools.
This includes ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and other assistants.
It requires both creativity and logical thinking.
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass focusing on a text input box labeled 'Prompt' on a clean digital interface. The cursor is blinking.

slides.title: AI: Your Smart Intern
content: It does what you say, not what you imply.
narration: To understand this, let's use an analogy.
Think of an AI model as your new, very bright intern.
This intern is super-fast and knows a lot, but is also very literal.
They will do exactly what you tell them, not what you just imply.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration: A bright, curious, and eager intern or assistant, holding a notepad and pen, ready to take instructions. Friendly cartoon style.

slides.title: Vague Instructions, Vague Results
content: Weak prompts lead to unhelpful answers.
narration: Now, imagine you tell your intern, 'Please make a report.' What happens?
The intern, being literal, might give you a very basic, generic report.
The result wasn't what you needed because your instructions were too vague.
This is exactly like giving a weak AI prompt.
slides.image_prompt: Scene: A manager vaguely telling a confused intern, 'Make a report.' The intern looks puzzled, later presenting a stack of generic, unorganized papers. Cartoon style, showing mild frustration.

slides.title: Clear Instructions, Great Results
content: Intern delivers a perfect, tailored report.
narration: But what if you give clear instructions?
For example, you could say: 'Create a report on the top three benefits of electric cars.'
State it's for your sustainable living blog.
Request it be under 400 words and in a friendly tone.
Now, your intern knows exactly what to do and gives a perfect report!
slides.image_prompt: Scene: The manager clearly giving detailed instructions to the intern. The intern nods confidently, then presents a well-structured, relevant, and visually appealing report. Cartoon style, showing positive outcome.

slides.title: The 3 C's for AI: Clarity, Context, Constraints
narration: AI works the same way.
Good prompts follow three C's: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Clarity means being specific. Context tells the AI why and for whom.
Constraints set rules for elements like length or format.
These C's help make sure AI gives you exactly what you need.
slides.image_prompt: Split screen: Left side shows a weak, vague prompt example. Right side shows an excellent prompt example, with keywords like 'Clarity', 'Context', 'Constraints' highlighted visually next to relevant parts of the prompt.

slides.title: Go Deeper: Advanced Prompting
content: Provide a 'Persona' (e.g., 'Act as a fitness coach').
Structure the Output (e.g., 'Present in a table format').
narration: You can go even further by giving the AI a 'persona'.
For example, instruct it to 'Act as a fitness coach'.
You could also structure the output, for example, by asking for a table.
For a full example, combine these techniques.
First, instruct the AI to act as a fitness coach.
Next, ask it to create a 3-day workout plan for beginners.
Finally, request the output as a table with columns for Day, Exercise, and Duration.
slides.image_prompt: An AI assistant icon wearing different 'hats' representing personas (e.g., chef, doctor). On the other side, a blueprint or table design showing structured output. Dynamic and illustrative.

slides.title: Key Takeaways
content: Good communication is your AI superpower.
narration: In summary, effective prompting means using clarity, context, and constraints for your AI.
Using personas and structured output makes your results better.
Remember, effective communication with AI is a powerful skill.
Practicing regularly is key to getting great results!
slides.image_prompt: An infographic representing the concepts. A central 'Brain' icon with radiating lines connecting to icons for Clarity, Context, Constraints, Persona, and Structured Output, all leading to 'Excellent AI Results'.

slides.title: Your Turn: Practice Prompting
content: Create a 3-day healthy meal plan for a student.
Include a persona, 3 C's, and table format.
narration: Now for your assignment, open any AI tool.
Imagine needing a simple 3-day healthy meal plan for a student.
Craft a prompt.
It should include a persona and apply the three C's.
Also, request the output in a table format.
Experiment with it and see the great results!
